purpose: Expand controlled-seed evidence and test finite-sample estimation of dispersion instead of oracle-only conditionality.
status: Design fixed before execution; all outcomes retained.
seeds: 41000 through 41029 inclusive, independent of the original five seeds
fixture: Reuse the original generator: 12 datasets, 6 types each, 200 test cells/group, 150 genes, fixed perfect conditional means.
experiment_1: 30-seed replication of Poisson, oracle group dispersion, and the original median-true-dispersion global control.
experiment_2: Independently sample training counts at 25, 100, and 400 cells/group; estimate pooled per-gene or group-per-gene dispersion using known mean residual moments. Evaluate on independent test counts at identical means.
estimator: theta = sum(mu^2) / sum((Y-mu)^2-Y), clipped to [0.05,1000]; nonpositive denominator uses 1000. No test-count access and no fitted oracle truth.
primary: Existing expressed-gene median absolute log2 variance-ratio error at count threshold 0.5, collapsed to dataset medians then seed medians; paired differences within seed. Show every seed and central 95% seed interval, not a confidence interval.
secondary: Existing multivariate energy distance for replication and the largest training sample. No claims about marker/classification or end-to-end performance follow from this synthetic experiment.
scope: Known means, negative-binomial ground truth, moment estimator, oracle group labels. Results do not validate amortized estimation or arbitrary real distributions.
protection: Do not overwrite any original experiment, figure-number ledger, or frozen upload. No optional stopping based on findings. Record all clipping rates and all per-group outputs.
